WITH pa AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region,
         AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS acc_avg_amt,
         AVG(t.balance) AS acc_avg_bal
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
rg AS (
  SELECT region,
         AVG(acc_avg_amt) AS avg_amt,
         AVG(acc_avg_bal) AS avg_bal
  FROM pa
  GROUP BY region
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall FROM rg
)
SELECT rg.region, rg.avg_amt, rg.avg_bal, rg.avg_amt / o.overall AS ratio_to_overall
FROM rg, o
WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL
